 Hyderabad Top News Gold rate today in Hyderabad, November 10, 2026: Check 22K, 24K and 18K gold prices
 Subhransu Satpathy 10 Nov 2026 10:27 AM Share this: HYDERABAD: Gold prices in India declined on Tuesday, November 10, with 24-carat gold falling by ₹490 to ₹1,44,110 per 10 grams. Meanwhile, 22-carat gold dropped by ₹450 to ₹1,32,100 per 10 grams.
 According to the latest rate update, 18-carat gold also fell by ₹370 to ₹1,08,080 per 10 grams. 
 Silver, meanwhile, stood at ₹205 per gram or ₹2,05,000 per kilogram. However, the latest update did not specify a daily change in silver prices.

 Gold rate today in India
 The following table shows the indicative gold prices in India on November 10, 2026.
 Gold purity 1 gram 8 grams 10 grams 
 24-carat gold ₹14,411 ₹1,15,288 ₹1,44,110

 Gold price today vs yesterday
 Gold prices declined across all three purity categories compared with November 9.
 Gold purity November 9 (10g) November 10 (10g) Change 
 24K ₹1,44,600 ₹1,44,110 -₹490

 On a per-gram basis, 24-carat gold became cheaper by ₹49, while 22-carat gold fell by ₹45 and 18-carat gold declined by ₹37.
 Silver rate today in India
 Silver stood at ₹205 per gram or ₹2,05,000 per kilogram on November 10, 2026.
 Silver quantity November 10 rate 
 1 gram ₹205 
 10 grams ₹2,050 
 100 grams ₹20,500 
 1 kilogram ₹2,05,000 
 These smaller-quantity prices are calculated from the reported kilogram rate. However, the latest update did not provide a day-on-day increase or decrease in silver prices.
 Why gold prices differ across websites and jewellery stores
 Gold prices may vary across websites because of differences in update timings, pricing methods and sources. For instance, some platforms publish indicative retail rates for individual cities, while others report national bullion benchmarks.
 The India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) publishes benchmark rates for different gold purities and silver. These rates may differ from the retail prices quoted by online platforms.
 Similarly, the final jewellery price depends on the gold weight, purity, making charges and applicable taxes. Buyers should also account for the 3% GST on the total transaction value of retail jewellery, including making charges.
 Therefore, buyers should request a detailed price breakdown from their jeweller before making a purchase.

 On November 10, 2026, 10 grams of 22-carat gold costs ₹1,32,100, while 24-carat gold costs ₹1,44,110. The 18-carat rate stands at ₹1,08,080 per 10 grams.
